fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2026-03-19, the complainant left a blue scooter bearing registration number TN-01-YY-1046 near Sevvanthi Colony Bus Stand Area and could not find it later. The time of the incident was given as 01:55 on 2026-03-19. The complaint was lodged by Durga Sekar (9000000467). Ganesh Shankar (9000000155) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. A further person, Siva Muthu, a friend of the suspect, using the number 9000000256, is stated to be associated with the incident. Yuvaraj Natarajan (mobile 9000000298) was named as a possible person of interest. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage and a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly taken after the handle lock was forced.
